defects.description: FALSE POSITIVE. Geometry sweep flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) because description contains the word floor. Instructions clearly say SIT on the floor and draw both knees fully into the chest — this is a SEATED knees-to-chest hug pose, NOT a reclining/lying pose. No globalTilt needed.

Instructions say draw both knees fully into the chest, wrapping arms around shins, rest cheek against a knee (forward hunch over knees). spine: -22 (raw) gives derived torso flexion -22 deg (BACK ARCH) — opposite direction. Should be POSITIVE forward flexion to bring chest down to knees. Same pattern as feet-up PR-v3 spine sign fix; this pose was missed.

Instructions say draw both knees FULLY INTO the chest (deep hip flexion ~110-130 deg, knees bent ~130-150 deg). Derived L/R hip flexion 80/80 (only forward sit, not knees-up), L/R knee 100/100 (right-angle, not deeply bent). Knees are not elevated to chest.

Instructions say wrapping both arms around the shins. Derived: L arm shoulder_abd 27, elbow 33; R arm shoulder_abd 35, elbow 30 — both arms at sides with slight bend, NOT reaching forward to wrap around shins. shoulderFwdL +7, shoulderFwdR -5 give derived sagittal flexion L +19, R +28 (slightly forward, insufficient wrap reach).

Instructions say rest cheek against a knee. Derived head pitch -22.8 deg (slightly back from spine -22). For cheek against knee (with knees drawn to chest), head should tilt forward ~25-35 deg. neck -16 only affects roll, not pitch.

regression_risk: medium-high - 10-field change. spine sign flip is well-precedented (feet-up PR-v3). Hip flexion 80 to 115 is large but anatomically valid (knees-to-chest sit). Knee 100 to 130-140 is valid. shoulderFwdL/R sign flip well-precedented. elbow moderate increase. neck small lateral tilt. Balance: COM shifts forward with hip flexion; spine 25 forward hunch compensates by bringing torso forward over hips. Should remain balanced.
rationale: Reclining flag FALSE POSITIVE (no globalTilt). Real defects multi-joint: (1) spine: 25 (was -22) — sign flip; description requires forward hunch over knees (knees-to-chest ball), not back arch. Same class as feet-up PR-v3 spine sign fix. (2) leftHip/rightHip: 115 (was 80) — deep hip flexion to bring thighs up to chest. (3) leftKnee 130, rightKnee 140 (was 100/100) — deep knee bend; slight asymmetry (10 deg) per tip Untuck one foot so it peeks out (less-bent knee = foot extends slightly). (4) shoulderFwdL/R: -45 (was +7, -5) — sign flip per inverted renderer convention; arms forward to wrap around shins. (5) leftElbow/rightElbow: 75 (was 65/45) — bent so forearms wrap around shins. (6) neck: 10 (was -16) — per FK neck rotZ + = head tilts figure left; tilts head left so LEFT cheek rests against LEFT knee. Combined: forward-hunched ball pose with knees in chest, arms wrapping, cheek on knee. Confidence moderate; 10-field change is large but each addresses a distinct description claim.
